description: This Dart source file defines the core service class for a Flutter-based ReAct agent system. It manages the agent's steps, interactions with chat services (including mock and live modes), execution of various tools (like file reading/writing, time retrieval, and calculations), and the main loop that processes user inputs and generates agent responses. It also handles exceptions and tool setup.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class encapsulating error types and details related to agent operations.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class managing the ReAct agent's core loop, tools, message history, and interaction with chat services in a Flutter application.

methods.name: setApiKey
methods.description: Sets or updates the API key used to toggle between live and mock chat modes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's internal state, including message history and running status.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the main agent loop, processing user input, interacting with chat service, executing actions, and building steps until completion.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step to the agent's step history and triggers UI update.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes the set of tools available to the agent, like file operations and calculations.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a specified action command using the corresponding tool.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated argument string into a list, respecting quoted strings.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Retrieves content enclosed within specific XML tags from a string.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds the system prompt string that guides the agent's reasoning and available tools.
